steps.journalDescription: I accepted the Director's offer. I must now seal the pocket on the bottom floor of the mine, and I will earn my freedom. I must first learn how to use the blasting jelly required to collapse the tunnel the worms are coming out of. I need to go to the mine entrance in the camp's southwest and enter the stockhouse there. Quartermaster Emese will be able to teach me how to use the blasting jelly.

I have been taught how to use blasting jelly. I now need to procure some. Quartermaster Emese said I'll need to make for the stockroom on the third floor of the mine. That's where the blasting jelly is kept.

I have what I need to end the worm threat for good, but assaulting the final tunnel will be difficult. I convinced Overseer Gáspár to allow me to look for more survivors before we make our attempt. I should scour the bottom floor of the mine for any sign of other survivors and enlist their help in finishing off the worms.
I have what I need to end the worm threat for good. I now should proceed to the sourthern most tunnel on this floor and find the cavern entrance that the worms originated from.

I have acquired a barrel of blasting jelly, but I don't know how to use it. I can find Quartermaster Emese at the stockhouse near the mine's entrance in the camp's southwest. She will be able to teach me how to use the blasting jelly.
I have ended the worm threat by collapsing the tunnel they entered the mine from. I should return to the Director's office on the second floor of the Manse in the west section of the camp.

I returned to the Director's office and told him that the mine is now secure. He has made me exempt from work, but says it will be weeks before my official pardon arrives by courier. He told me that he would announce my pardon to the camp.
